blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–As television cameras are slowly rising on each green of the Masters layout of the Manila Southwoods here, Filipino bets—one after the other—are sampling the world-class layout ahead of the foreign field just to arm themselves with the familiarity and the best chance of winning the 108th Philippine Open that tees off next week. Carl Corpus and Justin Quiban, young local guns given big chances to rule the $1 million (around P64 million) —the biggest purse in its long history—championship presented by the Philippine Sports Commission, played the course at the height of the heat on Monday afternoon as they […]...
